name: save_daily_summary
description: Save daily summary data to storage. Wraps the summary with metadata and saves to app/daily_summaries/ for the daily summary UI page to display.

inputs.name: summary_data
inputs.description: The daily summary data dict (with narrative, schedule, email_triage, news, etc.).

inputs.name: date_str
inputs.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.
